blocks.title: JANUARY 14, 3028
blocks.text: CERANT, AN TINGGALEDON MILITARY DISTRICT, DRACONIS COMBINEJANUARY 14, 3028WOLF'S DRAGOONS DEFEAT KURITA RYUKENHEAVY FIGHTING BETWEEN KURITA HOUSETROOPS AND THE MERECNARY UNIT WOLF'SDRAGOONS HAS LEFT THE CITY OF CERANT INRUIN. REPORTS INDICATE AN TING IS UNDERDRAGOON CONTROL.  TREACHERY AND BREACH OFCONTRACT ON THE PART OF KURITA ARE CLAIMEDBY THE DRAGOON'S. OFFICIALS FOR HOUSEKURITA ARE MAKING SIMILAR ACCUSATIONSAGAINST THE MERCENARY GROUP. IN A MESSAGEDIRECTED AT THE KURITA HIGH COMMAND,DRAGOON LEADER JAIME WOLF HAS CALLED FOR ACHALLENGE OF HONOR ON THE ICE WORLD OFMISERY.  WHO THE INFAMOUS WOLF'S DRAGOONSWILL WORK FOR NOW HAS NOT BEEN ANNOUNCED ATTHIS TIME, BUT SOURCES INDICATE THAT HANSEDAVION HAS EXTENDED AN INVITATION TO THEMERCENARY UNIT.

blocks.text: CERANT, AN TINGGALEDON MILITARY DISTRICT, DRACONIS COMBINE2 JANUARY 3028RIOTING SHAKES CAPITAL OF AN TINGWIDESPREAD RIOTING BROKE OUT TODAY IN MANYPARTS OF THE CITY. THE CRISIS IS REPORTEDTO BE DUE TO TENSION BETWEEN LOCALRESIDENTS AND MERCENARY TROOPS EMPLOYED BYTHE COMBINE.  RELATIONS CAME TO A HEAD WITHTHE DEATH OF THREE CIVILIANS LAST NIGHT INA LOCAL BRAWL INVOLVING MEMBERS OF THEMERCENARY UNIT WOLF'S DRAGOONS.  IN ARELATED STORY, AN INDEPENDENT GROUPCLAIMING TO BE KURITA PATRIOTS HAVECAPTURED THE HEPHAESTUS, THE FAMOUS ORBITALSTATION BELONGING TO WOLF'S DRAGOONS. THEHIJACKER'S ARE DEMANDING THAT ALLDRAGOON'S LAY DOWN THEIR WEAPONS ANDSURRENDER THEMSELVES TO JUSTICE.

blocks.text: VALENSIA, ANDER'S MOONDRACONIS MARCH, FEDERATED SUNSSENIOR COUNCIL PREPARES FOR FISCAL BATTLEAS THE SENIOR COUNCIL PREPARES TO COME BACKTO WORK THERE IS MUCH SPECULATION ABOUT HOWTHEY WILL HANDLE THE GROWING BUDGETPROBLEMS. THE RAID ON THE VANDENBURG ESTATELAST YEAR AND THE LOSS OF FOCUSEDLEADERSHIP HAS BROUGHT A HOST OF FINACIALPROBLEMS DOWN ON THE HEADS OF ANDER'SMOON'S GOVERNMENT. THE MCBRIN CLAN HASBEEN HARD AT WORK LOBYING THE COUNCIL FORMANY CHANGES IN THE BUDGET AS WELL ASCHANGES IN THE LOCAL LAWS. EASING THESTRICT ENVIRONMENTAL RULINGS WILL OPEN THEMOON TO MORE OPPORTUNITIES AND SO EASE THEGROWING FINANCIAL BURDEN.

blocks.text: VALENSIA, ANDER'S MOONDRACONIS MARCH, FEDERATED SUNSFINANCIAL SERVICES COMPANY OPENINGCLAN MCBRIN HAS ANNOUNCED THE OPENING OF ANEW BUSINESS HERE IN VALENSIA. NAMED DWFINANCIALS, IT WILL PROVIDE A HOST OFFINANCIAL SERVICES TO THE COMMUNITY. "WEARE MOST CONCERNED WITH THE STATE OF THELOCAL ECONOMY AND SEE THIS AS A WAY TOINFUSE THE BUSINESS COMMUNITY WITH SOMEBADLY NEEDED ENERGY." SAID FOUNDER JARRISMCBRIN.

blocks.title: valensia news
blocks.text: VALENSIA, ANDER'S MOONDRACONIS MARCH, FEDERATED SUNSANDER'S MOON ECONOMY REELINGLEGAL HASSLES SURROUNDING THE FREEZING OFTHE VANDENBURG ASSESTS STILL HAS MANYPEOPLE OUT OF WORK AND MUCH OF THE ECONOMYIN DISTRESS, SAYS A RECENT REPORT TO THESENIOR COUNCIL. "WE EXPECT FOOD SHORTAGESAND A LOSS OF MOST BASIC SERVICES WITHINTHE QUARTER." SAID THE SPOKESPERSON FOR THEREPORT'S STUDY GROUP. MEANWHILE, ARESTLESS WORKFORCE AND ALMOST DAILY STRIKESCONTINUE TO PLAGUE THE BUSINESS COMMUNITY.ADVISOR TO THE COUNCIL, JARRIS MCBRIN HASVOLUNTERED TO TAKE TEMPORARY CONTROL OF THEVANDENBURG BUSINESS HOLDINGS IN AN EFFORTTO GET THINGS MOVING AGAIN.

blocks.text: VALENSIA, ANDER'S MOONDRACONIS MARCH, FEDERATED SUNSSACRIFICIAL FORESTS AND THE MONEY GODEDITORIAL BY ALICIA ROWELARGE FARMING AND MINING CONCERNS LOST NOTIME IN CLAIMING LAND RECENTLY VOTED INTOPUBLIC USE BY THE SENIOR COUNCIL. MANY OFTHE ENVIRONMENTAL LAWS RECENTLY OVERTURNEDBY THE MCBRIN CONTROLLED COUNCIL HAVEOPENED THE WAY FOR WIDESPREAD DESTRUCTIONOF THE ENVIRONMENT. AS OF TODAY, THE ONCESACRED VANDENBURG RESERVE IS BEING CLEAREDAT THE ALARMING RATE OF 50 ACRES A MINUTE.MORE ALARMING IS THE FACT THAT MUCH OF THELAND IS BEING CLEARED FOR THE MINING OFRADIOACTIVES, AN ACTIVITY THE CITIZENS OFTHIS PLANET HAVE LONG VOTED AGAINST. I AMNOT OPPOSED TO CHANGE, BUT I AM OPPOSED TOUNPLANNED EXPANSION THAT THREATENS OURFUTURE.

blocks.text: VALENSIA, ANDER'S MOONDRACONIS MARCH, FEDERATED SUNSWINEMAKERS MAKE DRAMATIC COMEBACKMCBRIN WINE CELLARS (PREVIOUSLY VANDENBURGWINE CELLARS) HAS MADE A REMARKABLECOMEBACK IN THE LAST YEAR. THE VINEYARDSWERE IN SERIOUS TROUBLE NOT SO LONG AGO.HAVING BEEN HIT HARD BY THE VANDENBURGFREEZE, THE COMPANIES WERE TEETERING ON THEBRINK OF EXTINCTION. MCBRIN GAINED CONTROLAFTER A COUNCIL DECREE GAVE HIM TEMPORARYSTEWARDSHIP OVER THE COMPANY, ALONG WITHSEVERAL OTHER VANDENBURG HOLDINGS. MCBRIN,WITH APPROVAL FROM THE COUNCIL, LATER SOLDTHE COMPANY TO HIMSELF (THUS CHANGING THENAME). AFTER AN INFUSION OF CASH FROM DWFINANCE THE WINERY WAS BACK ON TRACK ANDBACK IN THE BLACK.

blocks.title: valensia news
blocks.text: VALENSIA, ANDER'S MOONDRACONIS MARCH, FEDERATED SUNSALLEGED MCBRIN CRIMES FALL ON DEAF EARSA LARGE CONTINGENT OF VANDENBURGSUPPORTERS PRESENTED EVIDENCE IN COURT TODAYOF ALLEGED WRONG-DOINGS BY COUNCILMAN ANDLOCAL BUSINESSMAN JARRIS MCBRIN. AMONG THECRIMES LISTED WERE USURY, EXTORTION, MONEYLAUNDERING, BRIBERY OF LOCAL GOVERNMENTOFFICIALS, FRAUD, EMBEZZLEMENT OF PUBLICFUNDS, BEARING FALSE WITTNESS, AND TAXEVASION. NO ACTION WAS TAKEN BY THE COURTAND NO WARRANT HAS BEEN ISSUED. JUDGETERRANCE BRINENS SAID THE ALLEGATIONS WEREPOORLY PRESENTED AND LACKED EVIDENCE STRONGENOUGH TO TAKE ACTION AGAINST MCBRIN. "THEMAN IS A LOCAL HERO. IT IS OF NO SUPRISE TOME THAT THESE MALCONTENTS WOULD WANT TOATTACK HIM." SAID BRINENS.
